Types

FileMetadata = object
  path*: string
  size*: int64
  lastModified*: Time
  visibility*: Visibility
  isDir*: bool
Metadata for a file or directory, including its path, size, last modified time, visibility, and whether it's a directory. This is returned by the metadata method and the list method of storage drivers to provide information about files and directories 
FlysystemStream = MemFile
LocalDriver = ref object of StorageDriver
Filesystem driver using an absolute runtime root. The root is set at runtime (from config/env), NOT at compile time. 
StorageDriver = ref object of RootObj
  root*: string
The StorageDriver type is an abstract base for different storage implementations. Concrete drivers (like LocalDriver) will implement the required file operations 
StorageError = object of CatchableError
Visibility = enum
  visPublic = "public", visPrivate = "private"
Defines file visibility options for storage operations. This can be used to set permissions or access controls
